slides.label: Step 1:
slides.title: Find EPA's action level
slides.body: Fix the home at 4 pCi/L or higher.

slides.label: Step 2:
slides.title: Ask for the seller's radon records
slides.body: In NJ, if the home was tested, the seller has to give you the results and proof of any mitigation when you sign the contract.

slides.label: Step 3:
slides.title: Test with a certified company
slides.body: Only state-certified companies can test for radon in NJ.
